tools.name: orchestkit_docs_search
tools.description: Search the OrchestKit documentation. Use this first to find the right page for a question. Input: a query string. Returns a ranked list of pages with titles and URLs.

tools.name: orchestkit_docs_get
tools.description: Fetch one OrchestKit documentation page as Markdown. Use after orchestkit_docs_search to read a page in full. Input: the page path (e.g. '/docs/getting-started/installation') or the result URL from orchestkit_docs_search. Returns the page Markdown.

tools.name: orchestkit_skill_get
tools.description: Show one OrchestKit skill as a card: what it does, which plugin ships it (ork or ork-extras), and the Claude Code install line. Use when a person asks about a skill by name. Input: the skill name, e.g. 'brainstorm'. An unknown name returns a 'no such skill' card with the nearest names.

tools.name: orchestkit_install
tools.description: Show how to install OrchestKit as a picker: Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, with the exact command for the picked host and a copy button. Use when a person asks how to install or set it up. Input: an optional host (claude, cursor or codex) to preselect.

tools.name: orchestkit_host_support
tools.description: Show what OrchestKit gives on each agent host (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Devin, OpenCode, Muse Code, Pi, Antigravity): what loads, whether hooks run, and the install command. Use when a person asks whether OrchestKit works in their tool. Input: an optional host id to preselect.
